skill_name: Summarize the article about human reproductive health.
workflow: Reproductive and sexual health is an important part of overall health and well-being. Reproductive health includes physical, hormonal, and biological changes, as well as the choices individuals make in order to have satisfying and safe sexual experiences. It also includes information about preventing and living with sexually transmitted infections.
